description: This file defines the ColumnDimension class within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It manages properties and behaviors related to worksheet column dimensions, including setting and retrieving column indices, widths, and auto-sizing options.

classes.name: ColumnDimension
classes.description: Represents and manages the dimensions of a worksheet column, including width, index, and auto-sizing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ColumnDimension instance with a specified column index, defaulting to 'A'.

methods.name: getColumnIndex
methods.description: Returns the column index as a string, e.g., 'A'.

methods.name: setColumnIndex
methods.description: Sets the column index as a string.

methods.name: getColumnNumeric
methods.description: Returns the column index as a numeric value.

methods.name: setColumnNumeric
methods.description: Sets the column index using a numeric value.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Retrieves the column width, optionally converted to a specified unit of measure.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Sets the column width, optionally converting from a specified unit of measure.

methods.name: getAutoSize
methods.description: Checks whether auto-sizing is enabled for the column.

methods.name: setAutoSize
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-sizing for the column.
